The body is curled in an embryonic posture. The entire image should have a soft, muted grayscale or a very light, desaturated clay-like color palette, giving the impression of an internal, X-ray-like view. A subtle grid pattern on the background further suggests a digital display. Focus on the distinct Ornithischian features, particularly the beak and general body plan, in an endearing clay style.
